nominee.longerDescription: Happy Woman Crush Wednesday! To stay fresh and up-to-date, here's the streamer I spotted at the "Women in Competitive Minecraft" show of TwitchCon. She was not just my favorite from the lineup in terms of looks, but also she seemed the most likeable, as she was mature and confident on stage as well as really fun and friendly, which is difficult to achieve all at once.
